subject: DELETE statement
notes: DIVERGES -> CONFORMS (kb/Work PB142). The DELETE FILE file-sharing conflict now answers '62' under EVERY retry form. Previously the SECONDS/FOREVER arm of FileRegistry.RetryLoop manufactured '52', and a GREEN golden (2023/delete_file_sharing, DELFV=52) RATIFIED that divergence -- corrected in the same change set, per the rule that a green golden pinning a divergence cannot close its row. The value is established NOT from GR15b's own sentence, which the PRINTED standard garbles as 'The valu62' is placed' (an ISO defect transcribed faithfully; LEDGER.json:4277 adjudicated it identically -- do not 'repair'), but from 9.1.13.9 item 2 and Annex E.3.3 item 35, both of which read cleanly and neither of which admits '52' for DELETE FILE. WHY IT WAS A WRONG-ANSWER DEFECT AND NOT TWO COSMETIC DIGITS: 9.1.13.1 keys the exception-name on the first digit ('5' -> EC-I-O-RECORD-OPERATION, '6' -> EC-I-O-FILE-SHARING), so a handler keyed on the file-sharing condition silently did not fire; 2023/pb142_retry_conflict_class_ec IS that handler and asserts EC-I-O-FILE-SHARING on all five retry forms. Two further legs pin the A.1 item 166 determination (maximum meaningful timeout value = 0): DELSC0 and DELSC30 must AGREE, which is the observable form of the clamp.
